name: Finnhamn
description: Moderate 10.1 km SAT hub section from Finnhamn brygga, looping across Stora Jolpan, Lilla Jolpan and Idholmen. Present it as a flexible island hike with gravel-road shortcuts, rocky shoreline, forest and meadow paths, pasture gates, beaches, viewpoints, Idholmen farm and summer services near the quay/hostel cluster. Several loops can be shortened back toward the hostel, restaurant, shop and ferry.
utilities: Länsstyrelsen confirms accessible toilets at the steamboat quay, on Idholmen and at the hostel, plus dry toilets/sopmaja in several places.
The tent-area water pump at [59.476425, 18.817320] is the strongest hiker-relevant water candidate after iteration 2; no official year-round guarantee was found.
Stugby hand pumps around [59.481605, 18.811287] and [59.481764, 18.810204] are plausible water points but partly guest/service-cluster context and should stay caveated.
Paradisviken and Vandrarhemsviken harbor water/electricity are boater infrastructure bought through OHOY and should not be exposed as free public hiker water.
Waste/sopmaja points exist at guest harbors and service clusters, but the app has no waste facility type and SAT's low-impact advice still supports taking waste back to the mainland where possible.
Hostel showers/toilets, sauna sea-water shower and stugby shower should not be exposed as free public utilities; they belong to guest, camper or booked-service contexts.
No public laundry facility was confirmed through iteration 2.
waterSources: Best public hiker-relevant water candidate: tent-area water pump at [59.476425, 18.817320], supported by Explore Archipelago campsite text and OSM coordinate support.
Caveated service-cluster water: stugby hand pumps at [59.481605, 18.811287] and [59.481764, 18.810204], supported by Finnhamn operator context and OSM pins.
Suppress paid harbor water/electricity at Paradisviken/Djupfladen and Vandrarhemsviken as general hiker refill unless the app explicitly models paid boater services.
No official year-round public water guarantee was confirmed through iteration 2.
notes: Route shape: round trip / hub-and-loops across Stora Jolpan, Lilla Jolpan and Idholmen.
This is a service-rich archipelago hub in summer, but many services are seasonal or guest/boater-context services.
Dogs must be leashed all year in Finnhamn nature reserve; do not treat the route as off-leash dog-friendly.
Fires are allowed only at designated fireplaces and only when no fire ban applies. Never light fires or grill directly on rocks.
Use fixed grills/common grills and charcoal/briquettes where required; do not burn branches or dead wood from the reserve.
Stay on marked paths where possible and do not damage rock, soil, trees, dead wood, plants, mosses, lichens or fungi.
Pasture sections require care around grazing animals: keep distance, leash dogs and close gates.
Terrain includes uneven roots, rocky shoreline, wet spring sections, boardwalks and slippery rock slabs after rain.
Treat bathing spots as natural/open-water bathing unless managed safety services are explicitly confirmed.
Plan outbound and return ferries before starting, and avoid relying on the last ferry connection.
If continuing to Ingmarsö, check rowboat status and weather before leaving the main Finnhamn loop.
H25 geometry is preferred for the route line, but the older 9.8 km PDF/Outdooractive route remains a stale official-source conflict until SAT republishes the print map.
For public hiker water, prefer the tent-area pump and caveated stugby pumps. Do not treat paid harbor water or booked/guest-service showers as public trail utilities.

Partial accessibility exists on the gravel road from quay to services, Paradisviken, Idholmen and farm, but the full SAT loop is not accessible because of technical coast, rocks, roots, pasture gates and wet sections.
Tick/TBE awareness is relevant in season; Stockholm coastal areas are a known TBE-risk context and tick checks are prudent from spring to autumn.
Treat swimming as unsupervised open-water swimming. Avoid green/murky algal-bloom water and use caution around rocks, cold water and boat traffic.

Wikivoyage-style claims that wind shelters are overnight shelters and that guest-harbor water is always readily available should be suppressed or rewritten because they conflict with reserve camping rules and paid harbor-water evidence.
Use green hand pumps where operational, but keep seasonal/operability caveats and tell hikers to carry water outside the main service season unless current water access is confirmed.
Iteration 4 coordinate QA found all current POI pins well aligned with the H25 route; Lammudden sits off-route and should remain an optional side-trip, while Talludden stays pending/internal.

Private water-taxi fallback candidates for Finnhamn are Rederi Gällnö, Gula Båten and Finnhamns sjötaxi, but these are paid booked/quoted services and should remain note-only rather than accessMetadata records. Do not list Edö Båttaxi as active.
Do not store exact commercial date/hour bands as normalized app data for Finnhamn. Use summer/seasonal/check-current-opening labels; exact hours belong only in source notes if needed.

facilities.name: Finnhamn brygga
facilities.description: Main ferry arrival and SAT start/end point; services cluster begins nearby at the restaurant, shop and hostel access road.

facilities.name: Finnhamn brygga public toilet
facilities.description: Accessible/public reserve toilet at the ferry/steamboat quay service cluster, confirmed generally by Länsstyrelsen with OSM coordinate support.

facilities.name: Finnhamns Café & Krog
facilities.description: Seasonal restaurant by the ferry/service hub. Operator page checked on 2026-04-26 still explicitly showed 2025 restaurant hours, so expose the service but do not hardcode exact current-year hours.

facilities.name: Finnhamns lanthandel / Sommarbutiken
facilities.description: Seasonal shop/resupply near the ferry quay. Operator page says daily June-August and low-season emergency assortment by phone, but the page is not explicit enough to treat exact dates/hours as confirmed 2026 data.

facilities.name: STF/Finnhamns vandrarhem Utsikten
facilities.description: Major lodging/service hub with hostel, cottages, guest kitchen and guest toilets/showers. Naturkartan says hostel is open year-round but mainly for larger groups in colder seasons; June-August has fuller service.

facilities.name: Södra tältplatsen Finnhamn
facilities.description: Designated tent area on Finnhamn with dry toilet, water and barbecue/fireplace nearby. Camping on the main trail islands should be treated as designated-site only.

facilities.name: Södra tältplatsen dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at the southern designated tent area; useful for hikers but tied to the campsite/reserve-service context.

facilities.name: Finnhamn tent-area water pump
facilities.description: Fresh-water pump at the tent-area service cluster. Treat as the best hiker-relevant water pin, but no official year-round guarantee was confirmed.

facilities.name: Södra Jolpan / Sydfladen fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fireplace/grill cluster by the south Jolpan tent area. Attach to the campsite context and apply strict fire-ban/fixed-grill wording.

facilities.name: Ragnars kiosk / Paradisviken
facilities.description: Seasonal beach kiosk at Paradisviken with ice cream, coffee, waffles, bread ordering, harbor-payment functions and kayak/SUP/rowboat rentals with life jackets. Operator page says mid-June to mid-August; exact hours should still be treated as current-page guidance rather than stable static 2026 data.

facilities.name: Paradisviken south dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at southern Paradisviken / guest-harbor beach edge. Hiker-relevant on the route, but should be described as guest-harbor/beach-edge context rather than generic island-wide service.

facilities.name: Idholmens gård / gårdsbutik
facilities.description: Working farm/farm shop on the Idholmen loop with seasonal produce, eggs and flowers rather than full grocery resupply. Swedish Explore Archipelago wording is stronger than the English page for seasonality: spring/early-summer/fall holiday opening and harvest-period daily 15:00-17:00 guidance.

facilities.name: Idholmen stugby-edge dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet on Idholmen near the cottage/tent-service side. Länsstyrelsen confirms toilets on Idholmen and OSM supplies the exact pin.

facilities.name: Idholmen rowboat-side dry toilet
facilities.description: Public dry toilet on the Finnhamn/Idholmen side near the rowboat meadow. Attach to sat-finnhamn, not to the rowboat connector.

facilities.name: Pojkarnas Udde barbecue spots
facilities.description: Two barbecue spots on the Idholmen coastal return, confirmed by official SAT step-by-step. Use only when fires are allowed and only at designated places.

facilities.name: Pojkarnas Udde dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet near Pojkarnas Udde / Idholmen coastal loop. SAT confirms the route and barbecue area here; OSM supports the exact toilet pin.

facilities.name: Idholmen grill/bathing spot
facilities.description: Mapped/photographed grill and bathing spot on Idholmen. Länsstyrelsen confirms designated fireplaces on Idholmen generally; use as a secondary rest/bathing POI, not as managed bathing safety.

facilities.name: Lilla Jolpan wind shelter
facilities.description: Wind shelter/rest-weather shelter on or very near the official southern Lilla Jolpan route. Do not label as overnight accommodation and do not imply a fireplace here.

facilities.name: Lammuddens wind shelter
facilities.description: Optional side-trip rest/fire POI, likely corresponding to the SAT side-detour shelter about 200 m off Sindra's Trail. Use only if optional side-trip shelters are supported; do not label as overnight accommodation.

facilities.name: Vandrarhemmet grillplats
facilities.description: Designated grill/fireplace near the hostel. Use fixed-grill/charcoal-only and fire-ban caveats; do not imply firewood collection.

facilities.name: Paradisviken
facilities.description: Sandy beach, guest-harbor/service landmark and activity hub on the Idholmen side of the loop. This is both a route landmark and a beach/service node; treat swimming as natural/open-water swimming unless managed safety is confirmed.

facilities.name: Idholmen farm and former strawberry-growing area
facilities.description: Working farm/farm-shop and agricultural/cultural landscape on the Idholmen loop. Länsstyrelsen lists the farm shop, Explore Archipelago describes the farm, and SAT notes the former strawberry-growing area nearby.

facilities.name: Vandrarhemmet Utsikten / hilltop view
facilities.description: Hilltop hostel/old-villa area with cultural and viewpoint value; also a major service/accommodation hub.

facilities.name: Lilla Jolpan lookout tower
facilities.description: Optional viewpoint/lookout detour on Lilla Jolpan. SAT explicitly recommends the detour, while the coordinate is inferred from map/OSM evidence.

facilities.name: Sindra's Trail
facilities.description: Pasture/forest route feature on Stora Jolpan. Expect grazing animals, gates and possibly wet spring ground.

facilities.name: Jordgubbslandet
facilities.description: Strawberry-growing heritage point near Idholmens gård. Naturskatter provides the interpretive story and SAT also notes the former strawberry-growing area.

facilities.name: Pojkarnas Udde
facilities.description: Coastal rest point on Idholmen with SAT-confirmed barbecue spots and local cultural history from Naturskatter.

facilities.name: Idholmen beach
facilities.description: Secondary swimming/beach POI useful if the app has a swim layer. Treat as natural/open-water bathing, not managed bathing safety.
